Name: 100% Specialty Arabica
Desc: A high grown Chandragiri Variety Arabica, shade-nurtured and hand-picked at peak ripeness, then finished with an anaerobic red-honey process for depth and sweetness.   Expect a smooth, refined cup with tasting notes of caramel, butterscotch, roasted nuts and a bright plum like finish.

Name: 100% Specialty Excelsa
Process: for a complex, fruit forward cup
Desc: A rare, resilient bean grown in select South Indian microclimates, hand picked and anaerobically processed for a complex, fruit forward cup. Expect a bold brew with notes of figs, grapes and almonds.

Name: 100% Specialty Robusta
Desc: A bold Peridinia grown at 800 m in Coorg’s fertile terrain, absorbing the richness from wild fig, silver oak and native shrubs. Expect a naturally intense, high caffeine brew with juicy stone fruit notes.
